description: This file defines ASN.1 structures and classes related to the 3GPP TS ASN1 NRPPA protocol, including message containers, procedure options, and PDU handling for the NRPP protocol.

classes.name: nr_ppa_elem_procs_o
classes.description: Object set representing various elementary procedures in the NRPP protocol.

classes.name: init_msg_s
classes.description: Sequence representing an initiating message in the protocol.

classes.name: successful_outcome_s
classes.description: Sequence representing a successful outcome message.

classes.name: unsuccessful_outcome_s
classes.description: Sequence representing an unsuccessful outcome message.

classes.name: nr_ppa_pdu_c
classes.description: Choice structure representing the main protocol data unit, which can be an init message, success, or failure outcome.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the type of the procedure or message.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the structure into a bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the structure from a bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the structure into JSON format.

methods.name: load_info_obj
methods.description: Loads object data based on procedure code.
